name: dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200

irregularities.what: the commands of privilege level 7: 2 statements
irregularities.statement: e.g. privilege exec all level 7 monitor capture

region: ! roles: the privilege lines of the levels tacctl renders
privilege exec all level 7 monitor capture
privilege exec level 7 clear mac address-table dynamic
after: ! If any line printed "% Invalid" or "% Error", stop and paste the back-out below.
! Check now (nothing rolls this back by itself):
!   From the tacctl server:   tacctl device config pull dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200 --diff     (roles: ok)
!   In the second terminal:   open a NEW ssh session to dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200 as yourself, then: terminal length 0, show privilege (must say 15)
! If both are fine, type this in the pasting session:
! To undo (paste in the second terminal, in configuration mode, before 'write memory' or after):
!   no privilege exec level 7 clear mac address-table dynamic
!   no privilege exec all level 7 monitor capture
!   (on IOS 15.x a removed privilege line may stay as 'privilege exec level <default> <cmd>'
! Do not: 'write memory' before the check; paste outside the banners; paste into another device;
! paste on a console more than twenty lines at a time; keep this output in a file after the paste
